summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting routine open-market share repurchases conducted through ABN AMRO Bank N.V. on the London Stock Exchange during July-August 2026. The company purchased approximately 2.7 million shares across three weekly periods at volume-weighted average prices between approximately 2,607 and 2,847 pence per share. All purchased shares were held as treasury shares, bringing total treasury holdings to 79.6 million shares. Year-to-date purchases totaled 75.5 million shares since January 2, 2026. This represents a continuation of RELX's ongoing capital return program rather than a discrete special-situation event.
